description: Runs when the `with` block starts; its return value is bound to the `as` target.
Runs on every way out of the block; the three arguments describe the exception, or are all `None` on success.
A true return value from `__exit__` swallows the exception; a false one lets `with` re-raise it.
`with A() as a, B() as b:` behaves like two nested `with` blocks: `B` exits before `A`.
`with` looks `__enter__` and `__exit__` up on the type, so methods attached to an instance are ignored.
